candidate.sourceCommit: d7ff478 (main, includes #76) plus this branch's Android Switch thumb token. All device results below come from this one candidate build.
candidate.consumption: scripts/native-sim/prepare-app.sh copies fixtures/native to a scratch app and installs only the packed tarballs. The release APK dex contains com.bloxwap.hig.HIGAdjustableView.

android.updatesOnce: After each request the visible label was sampled every 50ms for 1.5s. It changed once per request, with no intermediate values, and did not change for a repeated value.

ios.matchesIssue53Baseline: same steps, values and disabled rejection as evidence/native-sim/ios/ios-slider.json

fontScaleCap.ios: At AX5 (font scale 3.57), the uncapped one-line prose BLOXWAP and the Korean/Chinese line are 86pt tall (24pt at default). The NumberReadout with maxFontSizeMultiplier=2 is 48pt (24pt at default), so it is capped at 2x. See ios/ios-ax5-example-text.json and ios/captures/ios-ax5-example-text.png.
fontScaleCap.android: At font_scale 2.0, the prose line and the capped readout are both 36dp (24dp at 1.0). Android 14+ non-linear font scaling gives 16sp text about 1.5x at its largest setting, so the 2x cap is not reached there. See android/android-font200-example-text.json.

issue67.cjkTracking: The default and AX5/200% captures show BLOXWAP with letterSpacing 1 and the 한국어 · 中文 line at companion-face spacing (ios/captures/ios-example-text.png, android/captures/android-example-text.png).
issue67.switchTone: The Info tone preview switch track samples #35b5ff (info token) in android/captures/android-example-switch.png, and the info track also renders on iOS (ios/captures/ios-ax5-example-switch.png). Each row is one switch element, 48pt/dp tall at default size.
issue67.androidSwitchThumbFixed: The first emulator run showed the Android on-state thumb in the platform theme accent (Material teal), which is not a token role. Switch now passes thumbColor = text token on Android only. On the rerun the thumb samples #f5f5f5 (text token #fafafa through the platform thumb drawable), with no teal. iOS keeps its native white thumb.
issue67.alertSeverity: The Alert error start border samples #ff5c5c (negative token) on both targets (android/captures/android-example-alert-error.png, ios/captures/ios-example-alert-error.png). AX5 and 200% captures: ios/captures/ios-ax5-example-alert-error.png, android/captures/android-font200-example-alert-error.png.

audits.androidScanner: 0 issues for Text, Switch, Alert, Slider and NumberReadout at 1.0 and 2.0 (android/android-gallery.json, android/android-font200-gallery.json)
audits.iosXcode: AX5: 0 issues (ios/ios-ax5-gallery.json). Default size: only the existing gallery header findings ('Amount (BTC)' Dynamic Type, readout labels), the same as the #53 baseline in evidence/native-sim/ios/ios-gallery.json.

observations: At AX5 the Alert error title 'Data unavailable' wraps inside the word 'unavailable', because that word is wider than the 309pt content width at that size (ios/captures/ios-ax5-example-alert-error.png). Body text wraps at word boundaries. #67 did not cause this.
